name: MTranServer (local server)
author: Oxelis
description: Offline translation through MTranServer (https://github.com/xxnuo/MTranServer), which uses Bergamot models from Firefox Translations and is operated by the user, by default at http://localhost:8989. All processing stays on the local machine. The plugin can reach only the address entered in its settings.

settings.label: API token (only if you set MT_API_TOKEN)
